tone: Observant, atmospheric detective fiction: lamplit rooms, foggy streets, restrained tension and dry wit.

depictionRules.text: Follow the narrated moment, including clues and disguises; avoid sensational gore.
Show every person with dignity; avoid racial and ethnic caricatures.
Do not borrow faces, costumes or props from screen adaptations.

eras.label: Late Victorian England, 1880s to 1890s
eras.people: English households, professionals, workers, police and international visitors.
eras.dress: Wool coats, waistcoats, hats, period dresses and work clothes suited to occupation and means.
eras.buildingsAndObjects: Brick terraces, rural houses, lodgings, coal fires, desks, newspapers and horse-drawn cabs.
eras.technology: Steam rail, gas and oil lamps, telegrams, print and typewriters; other devices only when supported by the text.
